entities.name: Udraka Rāmaputra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Uddaka Rāmaputta was a sage and teacher of meditation identified by the Buddhist tradition as one of the teachers of Gautama Buddha. 'Rāmaputta' means 'son of Rāma', who may have been his father or spiritual teacher. Uddaka Rāmaputta taught refined states of meditation known as the jhāna formless attainments.
